q: Why are attention scores divided by the square root of the head dimension?
options: To keep score magnitudes moderate so softmax does not saturate
explain: Without scaling, large dot products push softmax toward one-hot weights and tiny gradients.

q: In a decoder, what does the causal mask do?
options: Prevents each token from attending to later tokens
explain: Each position may see only itself and earlier positions.

q: A model has 64 query heads and 8 key-value heads. How much smaller is its KV cache than full multi-head attention with 64 KV heads?
explain: The cache scales with KV heads: 64 ÷ 8 = 8×.
